dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: High-contrast, thick white horizontal band visible across the greater coverts against a darker grey-green background.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Sharp, distinct pale white margins along the outer webs of the folded primary and secondary feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: Small, roughly triangular pale yellow-white patch visible on the central posterior nape.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Sharp and distinct linear boundary separating the black posterior nape from the olive-green mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Large, high-contrast white auricular patch entirely enclosed by a black facial hood and throat bib.
